rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being financially able to bear a cost or expense.

example.english: We can afford this medical bill now.
example.traditional: 我哋而家負擔得起呢筆醫療費。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 fu6 daam1 dak1 hei2 ni1 bat1 ji1 liu4 fai3

rows.note: Use this specifically when saying that someone can afford to buy an item.

example.english: I can finally afford to buy this phone.
example.traditional: 呢部手機我終於買得起喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 maai5 dak1 hei2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the resource that can be spared is time rather than money.

example.english: I can afford to make time for dinner with you on Saturday.
example.traditional: 我星期六抽得出時間同你食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing1 kei4 luk6 cau1 dak1 ceot1 si4 gaan3 tung4 nei5 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for being able to afford to lose a game, bet, opportunity, or other valuable thing.

example.english: We can afford to lose this game.
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 syu1 dak1 hei2
